name: SynAjax
description: Ajax-only Contact Submit — require AJAX/JS to submit contact forms as a spam-control measure.
project_description: SynAjax adds an AJAX-only submission requirement to Drupal contact forms as a lightweight spam-control measure. On contact forms that already submit via AJAX, it appends a validate handler that rejects any POST lacking the Drupal AJAX flag, blocking naive bots that post directly without running JavaScript. A settings form under Configuration > Content authoring selects whether the requirement applies to all contact form bundles, a custom subset, or is disabled.
